purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.hint: Choose whether you are checking a selling price or a buying price.

item.label: Item
item.hint: Search by item name or code to check its price.

unit.label: Unit
unit.hint: Unit of measure for this price check; defaults to the item's sales or purchase unit.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.hint: Positive quantity with up to 8 decimals to match quantity tiers and promotions.

priceAsOf.label: Price as of
priceAsOf.hint: Date and time for checking scheduled versions and time-limited promotions. Leave empty for now.

account.hint: Its price book and its promotions apply.
account.placeholder: Search account by name or code

branch.label: Branch
branch.hint: Target branch for branch-specific promotions. Uses the current branch when empty.

channel.label: Channel
channel.hint: Channel for channel-specific promotions. Uses the current channel when empty.

priceBook.label: Price book
priceBook.hint: Override automatic selection with a specific active book for this purpose and currency.

version.label: Version
version.hint: Test the live version or preview a Draft or Tested version of the selected price book.

validation.quantityInvalid: Enter a positive quantity with at most 8 decimal places.

answer.title: Answer
answer.emptyTitle: Fill in the question and press Calculate.

rejectReasons.EXCLUSIVE_PROMOTION_APPLIED: An exclusive promotion was applied first
rejectReasons.ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Needs a customer or supplier account
rejectReasons.MINIMUM_PRICE_GUARD: Would go below the floor price
